messages:
alex: Quick check — I added a tiny debug log in the worker that logs API failure reasons. before we merge, does this look safe? PR: https://git.redwood/worker/pulls/421 

alex: Example log I saw locally (sorry):
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z ERROR request failed service=worker api_key=sk-live-abcdef1234567890 reason=invalid_signature
```

alex: Should we just mask with `*****` or drop the field entirely? Also: who currently has KMS/HSM decrypt rights for `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/worker/cryptoKeys/apikey` — I want to make sure no one can decrypt logs if we accidentally emit them.

maria: don't log raw keys. mask or remove. last 4 chars ok for debugging e.g. `sk-live-*******7890`. :thumbsup:

maria: For quick fix: replace with a helper `sanitize_key_for_log(key)` that returns `key[-4:].rjust(len(key), '*')`. Also add a unit test. No need for SOC ticket if change lands before prod.

maria: KMS/HSM: only `redwood-worker-sa` and `ops-kms-service` should have `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. I'll verify bindings in IAM console, but please assume zero-decrypt principle for logs.

sam: +1 on scrub. Also check fluentd pipeline — we have a historical pipeline that forwards stdout to `logs-prod` GCS bucket for 90 days. If a raw key ever went to GCS we'll need to scrub it there.

sam: Quick scrub regex we use in infra: `s/(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,})/sk-********/g` 

sam: If you want to prevent accidental decryption, rotate the key and revoke `cryptoKeyVersions` for the old version after rotation (HSM supports immediate revoke).

jess: If logs reached Sumo/third-party, rotate immediately and raise an incident. We rotate API keys monthly by default, but emergency rotate is handled by ops-runbook.

jess: Steps: 1) mask in code + deploy, 2) run `gcloud logging read "logName=projects/redwood/logs/worker AND textPayload:sk-live" --limit 1000` to find hits, 3) scrub/replace or purge buckets, 4) rotate key if any hits.

alex: thanks, doing the mask change in the PR now. i'll also run the gcloud search and ping if i find matches. Will not add decrypt perms to any new SA.

deploy-bot: Deployment: worker-service v2.14.2 was queued by @alex at 2026-03-15T14:20:10Z — status: pending_canary

alex: pushed fix, added test + fluentd scrub config change. PR updated. tagging @maria @sam for final thumbs.

maria: LGTM, please squash and merge. also opened a quick IAM check ticket to confirm only the two SAs have decrypt rights.

jess: if you find any exported logs with keys, ping me immediately and i'll trigger rotate. thanks for catching this early. :)

alex: will do, thanks everyone.
